issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. The scaffold weights come from train_smiles only. Neither test_smiles nor any test labels are used, and there is no file or network access.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The weights are 1/sqrt(scaffold count), scaled to mean 1, and passed correctly to both the random forest (RF) and LightGBM. Ranks are averaged the same way as before.
Minor robustness point: MurckoScaffoldSmiles(mol=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)) would fail if a SMILES did not parse. The run finished, so the current data is not affected.

Recomputed z, assuming noise sd 0.0049 per run: SE = 0.0049*sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.0060. z = (0.0893 - 0.0951) / 0.0060 ≈ -0.97. This matches the harness value of -0.954 apart from rounding of the inputs. The candidate scored worse by about 0.0058 and the difference is not significant, so the reject decision is consistent with the numbers.
